cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I ticked all the wedding bookings like you did. Now the couples have cancellation emails; please call them while I sort the screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ticked them to export the list. You pressed cancel. The log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the selected list. Keep that log here; give the couples replacement dates while I check it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Bulk restore sends an email naming whoever cancelled. I could put the dates back manually, but that takes all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put them back manually. I'll stay and read every date out; you won't have to do the afternoon alone.

reason: Make B explicitly offer the manual alternative and its labor cost; A accepts that cost rather than inventing software behavior.
